_note: Fictional sample calls for the workshop. Northwind Bank and Contoso BPO are sample names. Any resemblance to real people or accounts is coincidental.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good morning po, this is Mark from Northwind Bank. Paalala lang po, this call is recorded for quality and training.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: May I speak with Ms. Andrea Villanueva? Para po ma-verify, can I have your date of birth and the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Ako ito. March 14, 1990, and 4471.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Salamat po, verified na. Tumatawag po ako about your credit card payment that was due last September 25.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oo, alam ko. Nawalan ako ng isang client this month kaya kulang ang budget. Here's my card number para sure ka: 4412 8890 1234 5678.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Naiintindihan ko po, mahirap talaga yan. Hindi niyo na po kailangang ibigay ang buong card number, okay na po tayo. Pwede po nating hatiin ang bayad: minimum amount due now, and the balance on October 15. Pwede rin po ang 3-month installment.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sige, minimum muna ngayon then the rest on the 15th.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Noted po. You can pay through the Northwind mobile app, online banking, or any Northwind branch. Your reference number is PA-20261001-118. Summary po: minimum due today, balance on October 15. May iba pa po ba?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wala na, salamat Mark.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Salamat din po, Ms. Villanueva. Ingat po kayo.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Hi, is this Mr. Ramon Castillo?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, speaking.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm calling because your personal loan account ending 2290 is 45 days past due with an outstanding balance of 38,500 pesos.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wait, who is this?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Sorry, this is Liza from Northwind Bank collections. Can you confirm your birthday for me?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: June 2, 1985. I thought I set up auto-debit already.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I see the auto-debit failed because of insufficient funds. Would you be able to pay the past-due amount this week, or would a payment plan help?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I can pay half on Friday and the rest next Friday.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That works. Please pay through the Northwind app or any branch. Your reference number is PA-20261001-122. So that's half this Friday and the rest next Friday. Thank you, Mr. Castillo.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Hello, Joy po from Northwind Bank, this call is recorded. Is this Mr. Paolo Garcia? For verification po, your date of birth and your mother's maiden name?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes. August 9, 1992, Mendoza.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you po. Tumatawag po ako tungkol sa overdue balance ng credit card ninyo, 60 days past due na po.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wala pa talaga akong pambayad ngayon, next month pa sweldo ko.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Sir, kung hindi kayo magbabayad today, ipapa-kulong namin kayo. And tatawagan din namin ang office niyo para malaman ng boss niyo.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Ano? Pwede ba yan?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Para mabilis, send niyo na lang po sa personal e-wallet ko, 0917 555 0142, at ako na bahala mag-post.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hindi ako komportable diyan. Tatawag na lang ako sa hotline.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay po, bahala kayo.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Northwind Bank card services, this is Liza. This call is recorded for quality and training. How can I help?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi, my card got damaged and the chip isn't working anymore.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm sorry about that, let's get you a replacement. For verification, may I have your full name, date of birth and the last four digits of your card?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Carla Mendoza, November 30, 1988, and 7732.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Ms. Mendoza, you're verified. I've requested a replacement card to your registered address. It usually arrives in 5 to 7 banking days, and your current card number stays the same.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Great. Is there a fee?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No fee for a damaged-card replacement. Your reference number is CR-20261001-045. Anything else I can help with?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's all, thanks!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're welcome, Ms. Mendoza. Have a good day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon, Joy po from Northwind Bank. This call is recorded. Ms. Teresa Aquino po ba ito? Pa-verify po ng birthday at last four digits ng mobile number ninyo.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Ako nga. January 5, 1979, 2208.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Verified po. About po ito sa auto loan ninyo na 30 days past due.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Pasensya na, na-ospital kasi ang nanay ko nitong nakaraang linggo, doon napunta lahat ng pera namin.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. So kailan po kayo magbabayad?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hindi ko pa alam... baka sa katapusan.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Kailangan po ng exact date. October 31 na lang po. You can pay via the Northwind app or any branch. Reference number PA-20261001-131.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sige na nga.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, bye po.
